children: Michael Sinensky, through Aeromaris MAS LLC, disclosed an 11.6% stake in Powerus Corporation’s common stock via a Schedule 13D. He filed the report on Oct. 13, 2026, after Powerus completed its merger and became a wholly owned subsidiary on Oct. 1, 2026. The position stems from the merger consideration and includes options, while separate preferred shares lift his voting power to about 18.9%.

Sinensky says he holds the shares "for investment purposes" but he may take a more active role as Powerus’s Co-founder and EVP of Marketing and Communications. He may "purchase or acquire additional shares" or sell, and he may "engage in communications... regarding its business, operations, governance, and control" with management, directors, or other shareholders.

Michael Sinensky is a U.S. investor and entrepreneur who owns and manages Aeromaris MAS LLC, a Puerto Rico investment vehicle. He serves as Co-founder and EVP of Marketing and Communications at Powerus Corporation. Aeromaris invests in growth opportunities and holds equity and options tied to Sinensky’s operating roles.

title: Michael Sinensky Discloses Investment at Powerus Corporation with 11.6% Stake
